text:
sanjay: Heads-up — saw a weird FP8-only quality spike on an L40S canary for orion-13b during warmup. small but consistent: increased perplexity on long-prefix tests when batch warmup > 1k tokens. :thinking:

maya: Can you paste the logs / perf traces? is this on continuous batching or single-request path?

sanjay: Continuous batching. Stack: runtime v2.8.1, kernel fp8-v3. On H100 the same config is fine. Logs show repeated KV eviction/reload for the same request during warmup window.

jordan: hmm evaporation sounds like fragmentation + async eviction interaction. Did you hit `kv_warmup_min_tokens` or `prefill_on_eviction` heuristics?

sanjay: We didn't touch heuristics — defaults are `kv_warmup_min_tokens=32` and eviction threshold 0.75. Here's a trimmed log sample:```
[2026-02-28T14:12:03Z] request_id=rd-12345 stage=serve kernel=fp8-v3 device=L40S batch_id=72 seq_len=4096 action=kv_evict reason=low_mem reclaimed=120MB
[2026-02-28T14:12:03Z] request_id=rd-12345 stage=serve kernel=fp8-v3 device=L40S batch_id=73 seq_len=64 action=kv_load src=cache
[2026-02-28T14:12:03Z] request_id=rd-12345 stage=serve kernel=fp8-v3 device=L40S batch_id=72 seq_len=4096 action=kv_reload_from_disk time_ms=45
```
Pattern: warm long requests trigger fragmentation on L40S allocator, eviction kicks in mid-prefill, then we reload which corrupts the FP8 activation scaling state leading to stochastically worse outputs.

tess: That matches a local repro I ran — smaller seeds show TTI spike and occasional NaN-ish logits in token 2..10 for longprefix scenarios. I saw drift only when kernel used `fragmented_allocator=true`.

maya: Is this limited to orion-13b? or model-agnostic?

tess: Repro'd on atlas-7b too, but magnitude smaller. Seems sensitive to KV footprint vs allocator fragmentation.

jordan: Could be allocator slab size + FP8 scale quantization coupling. On H100 we have larger warp-friendly allocations so fragmentation less likely. L40S allocator rounds differently.

sanjay: Quick mitigation: turn off continuous batching for long-prefix routes or bump `kv_warmup_min_tokens` to 128. I shadow-deployed a patch that sets `kv_warmup_min_tokens=128` and `prefill_eviction_backoff_ms=250` — quality returned to baseline in canary (no perf e2e regression yet).

maya: Nice. Can you open a runtime issue with data, repro steps, and the trace? Also add a candidate kernel flag `disable_fragmented_alloc=true` so we can A/B it without changing allocator globally.

sanjay: Will create issue and add test harness. Repro steps: 1) enable continuous batching; 2) send a mix of long (4k) and short (64) sequences at 40 rps; 3) sample quality on our longprefix eval set; 4) compare fp8-v3 on L40S vs H100.

jordan: Also add a micro-benchmark that toggles `fp8_activation_rescale` path — we suspect order-of-ops with reload is losing per-channel scale metadata.

infra-bot: deploy/patch queued by sanjay: runtime/v2.8.2-warmup-fix -> staging (sha: a1b2c3d). :gear:

maya: Thanks. Once issue is up ping me and i'll schedule a dedicated kernel bakeoff: fp8-v3 with `fragmented_allocator` on/off, `kv_warmup_min_tokens` {32,64,128,256}, and `prefill_eviction_backoff_ms` {0,100,250}. We'll collect PPL and token-level KL vs fp32 baseline.

tess: I'll run the atlas/orion combos and post measurements. early note: 128 seems sweet spot on L40S for our workload.

sanjay: Filing issue now: https://redwood/intern/issue/INF-8721 — includes logs, repro harness, and the canary snapshot. We'll iterate. :thumbsup:
